title: Recommending for a Multi-Sided Marketplace: A Multi-Objective Hierarchical Approach
authors: Yuyan Wang; Long Tao; Xian Xing Zhang
eligible_reason: Multi-objective hierarchical recommender deployed on Uber Eats, evaluated with offline Pareto frontiers and LinUCB on randomized-rank sessions and an online A/B test. No DiD or event-study design.
design_notes: Code_for_offline_Pareto_frontier_and_LinUCB.ipynb and Code_KS_test.ipynb on session-store impression data with randomized ranks.
data_files_note: README.txt: 'All the columns here have been added noise to prevent showing Uber confidential information.'
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text and papers/ checked Nov 2); the OpenAlex abstract in data/frame/mksc.jsonl is a one-sentence summary. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
